title: KLIPIT

shot_prompts.phone: close-up of a smartphone on a dark gaming desk at 6 AM, screen glowing with a huge notification, lime green light spilling across a mechanical keyboard, a hand reaching for it
shot_prompts.asleep: young Black streamer asleep with his head on his gaming keyboard, headset around his neck, dark bedroom, lime green rim light from monitors, realistic

vo_lines: Six hours live... and the best play happened at hour four.
Nobody saw it. You were asleep.
Klipit finds your best moments. From one link.
Forty clips. Cut for Reels, TikTok and Shorts.

end.tagline: Paste your stream. Get your best clips.

caption: Six hours live, and your best play happened at hour four. Klipit finds it for you: paste your YouTube, Twitch or Kick link and get up to 40 vertical clips for Reels, TikTok and Shorts. Scan the QR to sign up, or go to klipit.onrender.com (link in bio).
